taxonomy.name: Chasing an extended entry
taxonomy.definition: Entry more than 2 ATR from the H1 20 EMA in the trade direction.

taxonomy.name: Late entry after the move
taxonomy.definition: More than 3 ATR of movement in the trade direction over the previous 6 bars.

taxonomy.name: No location edge (mid-range entry)
taxonomy.definition: Entry between 40% and 60% of the 50-bar range: neither at support nor resistance.

taxonomy.name: Entering into an opposing level
taxonomy.definition: Nearest opposing swing level is closer than 1R away.

taxonomy.name: Buying the top of the range / selling the bottom
taxonomy.definition: Long in the top 10% (short in the bottom 10%) of the 50-bar range with a reversal or mean-reversion setup.

taxonomy.name: Premature entry
taxonomy.definition: Stopped out, but the same idea entered 1 or 3 bars later would have made money.

taxonomy.name: Signal arrived late (move was inside the signal bar)
taxonomy.definition: Losing trade where entering one bar earlier (before the signal existed) would have won.

taxonomy.name: False breakout
taxonomy.definition: Breakout-type trade stopped out without ever reaching +0.5R.

taxonomy.name: Failed breakdown
taxonomy.definition: Breakdown-type short stopped out without ever reaching +0.5R.

taxonomy.name: Breakout without compression
taxonomy.definition: Breakout taken while Bollinger width was in the top 30% of the last 250 bars (no prior squeeze).

taxonomy.name: Low-conviction breakout candle
taxonomy.definition: Breakout candle body under 0.5 ATR or closing in the bottom half of its range.

taxonomy.name: Breakout straight into the prior day's extreme
taxonomy.definition: Breakout with the previous day's high (for longs) / low (for shorts) less than 1 ATR ahead.

taxonomy.name: Stop hunted
taxonomy.definition: Stopped out, then price reached the original target within 24 hours.

taxonomy.name: Stop parked at obvious liquidity
taxonomy.definition: Stop beyond equal highs/lows that sit behind the trade (a known liquidity pool).

taxonomy.name: Trading toward unswept liquidity on the wrong side
taxonomy.definition: Reversal trade while equal highs/lows in the opposite direction remained unswept nearby.

taxonomy.name: Entering on the sweep candle itself
taxonomy.definition: Continuation trade whose signal bar has a wick of more than 40% against the trade.

taxonomy.name: Continuation into trend exhaustion
taxonomy.definition: Continuation trade with price more than 3 daily ATR beyond the daily 50 EMA.

taxonomy.name: Momentum divergence ignored
taxonomy.definition: Continuation long on a bearish RSI divergence (or short on a bullish one).

taxonomy.name: Climax-bar entry
taxonomy.definition: Entry right after a bar of more than 2.5 ATR range in the trade direction.

taxonomy.name: Fading strong momentum
taxonomy.definition: Reversal/mean-reversion trade against a move with ADX > 35 and efficiency ratio > 0.5.

taxonomy.name: Countertrend entry (daily)
taxonomy.definition: Trade direction opposite to the daily 50 EMA slope.

taxonomy.name: Multi-timeframe conflict
taxonomy.definition: H1, H4 and D1 trend directions do not agree.

taxonomy.name: Trend-following in chop
taxonomy.definition: Continuation trade with efficiency ratio(30) < 0.15 and ADX < 18.

taxonomy.name: Catching a falling knife (reversal vs strong HTF trend)
taxonomy.definition: Reversal trade against a daily trend whose 20-day move exceeds 3 daily ATR.

taxonomy.name: Continuation misread as reversal
taxonomy.definition: Reversal trade stopped out after which price extended more than 2R further the other way within 24h.

taxonomy.name: Reversal misread as continuation
taxonomy.definition: Continuation trade stopped out after which price went more than 3R the other way within 24h.

taxonomy.name: H1 structure misread
taxonomy.definition: Long while H1 swing structure is LH/LL (bearish), or short while HH/HL.

taxonomy.name: H4 structure against the trade
taxonomy.definition: H4 swing structure opposite to the trade.

taxonomy.name: Fading a level that has been tested repeatedly
taxonomy.definition: Reversal at a level touched 4+ times already (levels weaken with each test).

taxonomy.name: Level broke through (S/R misinterpretation)
taxonomy.definition: Level-based reversal stopped out with the level decisively broken (price ran > 1.5R beyond the stop afterwards).

taxonomy.name: Into a higher-timeframe level
taxonomy.definition: Nearest opposing H4 or daily swing level is closer than 1R (significant levels only).

taxonomy.name: Selling into higher-timeframe support / buying into resistance
taxonomy.definition: Continuation trade with an opposing H4/D1 level within 0.5 ATR.

taxonomy.name: Round-number magnet ignored
taxonomy.definition: Entry within 0.3 ATR of a $50 handle.

taxonomy.name: Consolidation trap
taxonomy.definition: Trade inside a tight 20-bar range (range < 4 ATR) that is not a breakout of it.

taxonomy.name: Range whipsaw
taxonomy.definition: Trade went more than +0.8R in favour and then hit the full stop.

taxonomy.name: Expecting a move in dead volatility
taxonomy.definition: Continuation trade with H1 volatility in the bottom 15% of the last 500 bars.

taxonomy.name: Entering after a volatility expansion
taxonomy.definition: Fast ATR > 1.5x slow ATR (expansion already under way).

taxonomy.name: Stop too tight for volatility
taxonomy.definition: Initial stop smaller than 0.75 ATR(H1).

taxonomy.name: Stop unnecessarily wide
taxonomy.definition: Initial stop larger than 2.5 ATR(H1), shrinking position size and R efficiency.

taxonomy.name: Target beyond a known obstacle
taxonomy.definition: 2R target lies beyond the nearest opposing level (target needs that level to break).

taxonomy.name: Target too far (should have banked)
taxonomy.definition: Reached +1R or more, then finished at a loss.

taxonomy.name: Target too close (left money on table)
taxonomy.definition: Hit the 2R target and price kept going to more than 4R within 24h.

taxonomy.name: Stop placement, not idea, was wrong
taxonomy.definition: Lost with the original stop, but the same trade with a 1.5x stop (same target) made money.

taxonomy.name: Wrong direction entirely
taxonomy.definition: Lost, and the opposite trade (mirrored stop/target) won at least +1R.

taxonomy.name: Thesis never played out (time decay)
taxonomy.definition: Exited on the time stop with |R| < 0.3.

taxonomy.name: Entry into scheduled news
taxonomy.definition: Decision inside, or one hour before, an FOMC / CPI / NFP window.

taxonomy.name: Illiquid-hours entry
taxonomy.definition: Entry during the 21:00-23:00 UTC rollover / thin Asia open.

taxonomy.name: Friday-afternoon / weekend exposure
taxonomy.definition: Entered on Friday after 14:00 UTC (trade likely to be held over the weekend gap).

taxonomy.name: Bollinger touch read as reversal while band-walking
taxonomy.definition: BB fade while price has closed outside the same band 3+ times in the last 10 bars.

taxonomy.name: Bollinger breakout in a range
taxonomy.definition: Squeeze breakout with ADX < 20.

taxonomy.name: Lagging MA cross
taxonomy.definition: EMA cross after price already moved more than 3 ATR over 12 bars.

taxonomy.name: Moving average as support in a flat market
taxonomy.definition: EMA pullback with |EMA50 slope| < 0.3 ATR per 10 bars.

taxonomy.name: Overbought != sell in a trend
taxonomy.definition: RSI-extreme or BB fade against an aligned H1/H4/D1 trend.

taxonomy.name: Wick rejection misread
taxonomy.definition: Wick-rejection trade stopped out without reaching +0.5R.

taxonomy.name: Failed retest
taxonomy.definition: Retest trade stopped out without reaching +0.5R.

taxonomy.name: Retest too deep
taxonomy.definition: Retest where the signal bar closed less than 0.2 ATR beyond the level after piercing it.

taxonomy.name: Gap through stop
taxonomy.definition: Exit filled more than 0.3R worse than the stop.

taxonomy.name: Cost-dominated trade
taxonomy.definition: Costs (spread + slippage) above 0.15R.

variants.base: As taken: market entry at next bar, structural stop, 2R target, 48h time stop.
variants.enter_earlier_1: Enter one bar earlier (at the previous bar's close/next open), same stop and target prices.
variants.enter_later_1: Wait one bar, then enter at market. Same stop and target prices.
variants.enter_later_3: Wait three bars, then enter at market. Same stop and target prices.
variants.confirm_close: Only enter if the next bar closes in the trade direction; otherwise skip.
variants.retest_limit: Limit order back at the signal bar's midpoint for 6h instead of chasing.
variants.stop_2x: Stop twice as far away (same target price).
variants.stop_atr2: Stop at 2 x ATR(H1) from entry (volatility stop).
variants.target_level: Target at the nearest opposing swing level (if beyond 0.5R, else 1R).
variants.breakeven_1r: 2R target, stop moved to entry once +1R is reached.
variants.trail_2atr: No fixed target: chandelier trailing stop 2 x ATR(H1) behind the best price, 96h max.
variants.trail_3atr_after_1r: No fixed target: 3 x ATR trail switched on after +1R, 96h max.
variants.partial_1r_trail: Half off at +1R, other half on a 2 x ATR trailing stop (96h max).
variants.opposite: Take the opposite direction with a mirrored stop/target.

tests.claim: I am better on the short side than the long side.
tests.test: Short avg R exceeds long avg R and the bootstrap 95% CI of the difference excludes 0.

tests.claim: My long-side weakness is explained by market conditions, not by skill.
tests.test: Most of the long/short gap comes from the regime mix (composition) rather than within-regime results.
Shorts taken WITH downside momentum (rel_mom6 > 1) beat both shorts against momentum and the random-timing baseline.
Trades that fade an extended move (>2.5 ATR against the trade over 6h) beat random timing and the lab's mechanical fades.

evidence.note: No random-timing baseline for mechanical trades; MAE compared.

tests.test: Short entries beat random entries on the same day with the same stop distance (positive timing alpha).

tests.claim: I can tell continuation from reversal.
tests.test: Both continuation-type and reversal-type trades are positive, and neither is worse than random timing.
